name: YITAMOTOR Replacement Headlights Compatible with 1994-2002 Dodge Ram 1500 2500 3500, Black Housing Headlamp Assembly, Driver & Passenger Side
fitment:
For 1994-2001 Dodge Ram 1500
For 1994-2002 Dodge Ram 2500 3500
Feature
Vehicle compatibility: headlights assembly compatible with 1994-2001 dodge ram 1500, 1994 1995 1996 1997 1998 1999 2000 2001 2002 dodge ram 2500 3500; high beam/low beam bulb type: 9007(HB5); bulbs are not included
Waterproof: fully sealed with solid silicon & designed with one-way vents to prevent moisture from being trapped inside the housing, no corrosion or moisture worries in sorts of weather conditions
Brighter lighting: the metallic parabolic reflectors provide more light output to create a broader and smoother beam
Safety reflector: the sided micro-prism reflector makes the oncoming cars or passersby quickly notice you at night, ensuring your driving safety and others'
Impact resistance: the polycarbonate lens & tough housing are highly resistant to shock, vibration for any tough road; professional installation would be highly recommended

description:
Factory-style headlights are identical to the original unit in every way— the same quality and the same method of installation. And every headlight assembly undergoes strict testing before it leaves the factory. All wiring is rigorously tested to ensure the light is completely functional. A new pair of headlights can provide you with up to 50% more illumination than dull, yellowed, sandblasted, broken, or scratched headlights.
Note: Professional installation would be highly recommended.
